meta.name: emails
meta.description: When the user wants to create or optimize an email sequence, drip campaign, automated email flow, or lifecycle email program. Also use when the user mentions "email sequence," "drip campaign," "nurture sequence," "onboarding emails," "welcome sequence," "re-engagement emails," "email automation," "lifecycle emails," "trigger-based emails," "email funnel," "email workflow," "what emails should I send," "welcome series," or "email cadence." Use this for any multi-email automated flow. For cold outreach emails, see cold-email. For in-app onboarding, see onboarding.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计并优化自动发信的邮件序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让客户在关键时刻自动收到你的邮件
copy.tagline_en: Design automated email sequences for key moments.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want customers to automatically receive your emails at key moments.

howto.what: Claude 会先读取已有的产品营销上下文(如有),然后询问序列类型、受众与目标,再产出完整邮件序列方案:每封邮件的主题、预览文字、正文、CTA、发送节奏,以及衡量指标。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建或优化邮件序列、滴灌式邮件、自动化邮件流程,或说出“email sequence”“drip campaign”等触发词时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新用户欢迎邮件序列
say.note: Claude 会先询问受众和目标,再产出邮件方案。

say.text: 我要为流失用户写一套召回邮件流程
say.note: 会生成 3-4 封召回邮件及发送节奏。

say.text: 优化我现有的培育式邮件序列
say.note: Claude 会了解现有表现再调整。

howto.what_en: Claude reads any existing product-marketing context, then asks about sequence type, audience, and goals. It outputs a complete email sequence plan: for each email—subject, preview text, body, CTA, send timing—plus a metrics plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to create or optimize an email sequence, drip campaign, or automated email flow, or says keywords like "email sequence," "drip campaign," etc.

say_en.text: Design a welcome email sequence for new users
say_en.note: Claude asks for audience and goals, then drafts the plan.

say_en.text: Create a re-engagement email flow for churned users
say_en.note: It will generate 3-4 emails and send timing.

say_en.text: Optimize my existing nurture email sequence
say_en.note: Claude will review current performance and adjust.
